TC_Name: Valid Login and Inventory Page Verification
Test Step:
1. Open https://www.saucedemo.com/
2. Enter username: standard_user
3. Enter password: secret_sauce
4. Click LOGIN
Actual: Inventory page loads and products are visible
Expected: User is logged in successfully and the inventory page displays products

Test Step: 1. Login with standard_user / secret_sauce\n2. On inventory page, click ADD TO CART for Sauce Labs Backpack\n3. Click the shopping cart icon
Actual: Selected item is added to cart and badge count updates
Expected: Cart icon shows badge count 1 and the Backpack appears in cart
